We drove all the way back here from Burlingame because it is so good. I’ve spent a year all over Greece and this restaurant is one of the very few that actually rivals real Greek food. Incredible lamb burgers!

Being my first time I went with the classic Big Mouth Burger medium rare. Big and juicy but nothing that made it stand out as far as in flavor. Fries were good, nice and crispy. Environment was peaceful and clean. Overall I will return to try other things on the menu like the SF Giants burger!

They have a pretty inconvenient seating system and had to wait around an hour to get seated and another hour to get our food (we did come during a busy time tho) but the burgers were delicious- loved the special sauce, cheese was melty, and …

Lovely’s has got to be one of the best burgers in the bay! We always go out of our way to enjoy the occasional cheat meal on the patio. There really isn’t a bad thing on the menu; though I will mention the Chillie Willie is my least …

I wanted to get a nice burger so I came here. I ordered a super duper burger with bacon and sauce on the side - pro tip this is importante so your burger doesn’t get soggy or bread mushy. I also got fries and soda. They ask for a tip but …
Super Duper Burgers. Restaurant. Duboce Triangle. 2304 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94114

Good quality burgers with reasonable wait times. Milk shakes were ok. Our garlic fries were an oily soggy mess. No table service, self-service sodas and free pickles. Seating is ok but not very comfortable, also the music is loud inside making it hard to have a conversation .

Iggy’s Burgers. Hamburger restaurant. The Castro. 4248 18th St, San Francisco, CA 94114. $20–30

This was a much needed place to have in Eureka valley! I've worked on this area over 2 years and it's so hard to find a decent burger close by.  Well Iggy's hit it out the park! JUICY THICK CHEESY and cooked too PERFECTION!! Fries are fresh …

Very impressed with Iggy's. Service was fast and efficient, food is good, and a libation with dinner is satisfying. I got the Iggy Burger, onion rings and uno cervaza. Multiple dipping sauce options. Try the smoked maple sauce on your onion rings. Grass-fed beef from sustainable farms in NoCal. Don't forget to tip the help!
Burger with sweet potato fries
Hi-Way is the best SF burger spot. The cheeseburgers are perfect every time (tip: add grilled onions and get spicy ranch on the side) …
Wanted burgers and beeps was too far so found this little gem and it was super worth it! Definitely would come back. Quick to get my order with nice indoor seating. Big fan!

The food here is really good. I have tried the burgers, grilled chicken, and fried chicken and would recommend them all. It's a good value for the price too. I also enjoyed the garlic fries (VERY garlicky!) and onion rings. My only nitpick …

A great first stop this afternoon in the Haight Asbury neighborhood. Early enough to take advantage of happy hour. The food and service were both great.  The sports bar ambience was nice for the soccer match.  We had the cheese burger, pretzel tray and a side of fries, all very tasty.
